cards.card_text: Then the Lord GOD of Hosts brings it home: "Your own evil will discipline you; your own apostasies will reprimand you." Ignore the oven timer, friend, and the smoke alarm does the scolding for you.
cards.verse_text: Your own evil will discipline you; your own apostasies will reprimand you.
cards.snippet: Your own evil will discipline you; your own apostasies will reprimand you.

cards.card_text: He will save them from all their apostasies and cleanse them.
cards.verse_text: I will save them from all their apostasies by which they sinned, and I will cleanse them.
cards.snippet: I will save them from all their apostasies by which they sinned, and I will cleanse them.
